summary: Microsoft and Hugging Face introduced ThinkingBox, a benchmark that runs AI agents through 507 business workflows many times, checking the actual changes an agent makes to a database rather than just the tool calls it reports. This shows that current testing methods miss hidden errors in agent behavior.
title: Microsoft and Hugging Face release ThinkingBox benchmark to test AI agent consistency
why_it_matters: The benchmark helps developers identify agents that reliably perform real‑world tasks, improving safety and user trust in AI assistants.
